description: Six envelope generators whose stage times are set by two end points, the four in between interpolated, each with its own trigger input and a gate marking the envelope's rest

params.text: Bends both slopes of every envelope from a fast attack with a long fall at one end to the reverse at the other
Shapes every envelope between exponential, linear and logarithmic
Sets the length of the first envelope, within the span picked by its RANGE button
Sets the length of the last envelope, within the span picked by its RANGE button
Attenuverts the slant CV, which is scaled so that 10V covers the whole slant travel
Attenuverts the curve CV, which is scaled so that 10V covers the whole curve travel
Attenuverts the first width CV, which is scaled so that 10V covers the whole width travel
Attenuverts the last width CV, which is scaled so that 10V covers the whole width travel
Steps the first envelope through three time spans, one lamp lit per span, each press moving to the next and wrapping round
Steps the last envelope through three time spans, one lamp lit per span, each press moving to the next and wrapping round
Fires the first envelope on each press, and through the normalling the other five follow it

inputs.text: Shifts the slant of all six envelopes, added to the slant knob through its attenuverter and clamped to the knob's own travel
Shifts the curve of all six envelopes, added to the curve knob through its attenuverter and clamped to the knob's own travel
Shifts the length of the first envelope, added to the first width knob through its attenuverter
Shifts the length of the last envelope, added to the last width knob through its attenuverter
A rising edge past 1V fires the envelope of that number; with nothing patched it takes its trigger from the nearest patched input to its left, or from the next channel of a polyphonic cable there

outputs.text: Carries 10V while the envelope of that number rests at 0V, and 0V while that envelope is running

notes: the six trigger inputs are normalled left to right, so one cable in the leftmost input fires all six in turn, each after the one before it has finished
a polyphonic cable in any trigger input feeds that input and the ones after it, one channel each, in place of the left-to-right normalling
the envelopes are computed at a tenth of the sample rate and the outputs interpolated between those steps, which is why the module is cheap to run
menu: Enable Retriggering — lets a trigger restart an envelope that is already running, rather than being ignored until the envelope reaches 0V
Enable Polyphonic Output to Channel 1 — gathers all six envelopes into the first envelope output and all six gates into the first gate output, as six polyphonic channels
